{{Top|leg}}
'''Magresh''' was a small-time criminal who stole a massive amount of medical supplies from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] camp warehouse run by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Noran Vran]]. Magresh then sold the supplies back to the captain in exchange for ten [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]]. Vran paid the price but had rigged one of the missiles to explode shortly after Magresh left, killing him.
